buildCommand: if [ -d flutter ]; then cd flutter && git fetch --depth 1 origin 3.44.8 && git checkout FETCH_HEAD && cd ..; else git clone --depth 1 --branch 3.44.8 https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git; fi && flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web && flutter/bin/flutter pub get && flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --no-wasm-dry-run
installCommand: echo 'sem install: o SDK vem no buildCommand'

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' https://www.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self' https://www.gstatic.com https://fonts.gstatic.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'
